ev.q: Helldivers is a 2015 top-down shooter video game
Helldivers is one of the best co-op action experiences you can have
the player must fight or sneak through enemy-controlled territory
the player needs to coordinate their actions during chaotic combat
resulting in continuous waves of enemy reinforcements
isn't easy, but this throwback to classic top down shooters is still a good time
players can choose their loadouts (sets of weapons, equipment, and gear)
